description: This file implements functions for replacing variables in an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) within the ANGLE project, including traversing nodes, replacing variables, and handling function prototypes and calls.

classes.name: ReplaceVariableTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the AST to replace specific variables with other nodes.

methods.name: ReplaceVariable
methods.description: Replaces all references to a specific variable in the AST with another variable.

methods.name: ReplaceVariableWithTyped
methods.description: Replaces all references to a specific variable with a typed AST node.

methods.name: convertFunctionPrototype
methods.description: Creates a new function prototype with potentially replaced parameters.

methods.name: convertASTFunction
methods.description: Replaces a function call node with a new call using possibly replaced arguments.
